property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always makes exactly _tos.length successful external transferFrom calls (one per recipient) and thus returns true; the mutant that starts the loop at 1 skips the first recipient so for some inputs the reference makes N calls but the mutant makes N-1, causing a difference in external observable calls (recorded by a helper) and potentially differing behavior.
change_summary: Change the loop to start at 1 instead of 0, so the first recipient is skipped and behavior (return true) may differ when _tos.length>0 but only one element was present.
